verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents a 'Repository Agent' AI assistant that you interact with through conversation to browse files, search content, read/modify files, commit, pull and push — directly supporting natural-language operation. However, this is a single first-party doc mention with no independent/hands-on corroboration, and other AI mentions (commit message suggestions) are narrower assistive features rather than full natural-language control of the whole tool. Missing for 10: independent verification of the Repository Agent's breadth/reliability, evidence of natural-language coverage across all git operations, and community confirmation of real-world use.
